blocks.text: The api service reaches dependencies by service name and container port, receives non-secret config via `environment:`, gets passwords as secret files, and uses the project .env only for interpolation defaults.

blocks.code:
api:
  build: .
  image: ghcr.io/acme/rag-api:${TAG:-dev}
  init: true
  environment:
    DATABASE_HOST: db
    DATABASE_PORT: "5432"
    QDRANT_URL: http://qdrant:6333
    EMBEDDING_MODEL: ${EMBEDDING_MODEL:-BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5}
    EMBEDDING_DIM: ${EMBEDDING_DIM:-384}
    WEB_CONCURRENCY: "1"
    HF_HOME: /models
  secrets: [db_password, openai_api_key]
  volumes: [hf_cache:/models]
  ports: ["127.0.0.1:8000:8000"]
  depends_on:
    db: { condition: service_healthy }
    migrate: { condition: service_completed_successfully }

blocks.text: `URL.create` escapes special characters; an f-string breaks on `@`, `/`, `:` in passwords.

Q: "How does the API find Postgres, and where does the password come from?" A: "By service name and container port, db:5432, on the Compose network, never localhost. The password is a Compose secret file read via pydantic-settings secrets_dir into SecretStr, and the URL is built with URL.create so special characters are escaped."

items: Secrets as files, config as env.
